artifact_core_digest_note: Reader A's OWN digest of the projection, printed by scripts/crystal_a2_project and taken over the domain-separated `clean.ir_mint.core.v1` prefix. `core_digest` above is ir_mint::digest of the same text under this crate's domain, which is a different constant; the two are recorded side by side rather than reconciled, because a reader that could not disagree with itself is not a second reader.
